opcodeMapping.summary: All retainer-marketplace c2s opcodes are already cataloged in existing manifests. Bazaar has no dedicated c2s opcode in 1.23b (handled via Lua event commands on generic event opcodes). 'Market' is a single PrivateAreaMaster zone name (PrivateAreaMasterMarket) plus MarketEntrance NPCs - no Market* opcode exists in 1.23b.
opcodeMapping.note: Opcode 0x01DD c2s side is cataloged via BCS-Y-0325 (FUN_004C7300, RetainerSearchHistory request, 0x118 bytes). The matching s2c receiver class is NOT in client_receivers.json - probably routed via the queue-walk path (parallel to the linkshell-chat finding in docs/packet-dispatch-map.md).

retainerItemSearchMarketplaceCluster.refinement: RetainerItemSearchMarketplace - small c2s record (one indexed slot value from caller's array at param_1[0x387]+idx*0x10). Sole caller FUN_0051A4A0. Maps to ItemSearchListWidget's owning hierarchy (sibling to FUN_00525E50 case-5 dispatch). Likely 'open search session' opening request that initiates the result stream subsequently filled by 0x01D8 / 0x01DF bodies.
retainerItemSearchMarketplaceCluster.reverifyMethod: live-validation against the retail 1.23b client in a live session

retainerItemSearchMarketplaceCluster.refinement: RetainerItemSearchMarketplace - ItemSearchListWidget tick handler case 6 emit (called from FUN_00525E50, the 10-case state machine on +0x1214). Reads 5 widget fields (+0x1220, +0x1224, +0x1228, +0x1234, +0x1238) plus per-index value from +0xE28+(+0x1228)*4. Gated on +0x123C == +0x1240 (per-step rate limiter). Sets state to 7 on emit.

Tier-D Map emitter via FUN_004C7150 passthrough -> FUN_004E0240. Sole caller FUN_00874750(param_1, 0x1E=category=30); takes param_1+0x14 as gate flag. Routed alongside 0x01DC and 0x01DD from the same caller-family (FUN_00874570/00874750/008746E0 share the same 3-arg signature pattern reading param_1+0x14 gate).

Tier-D Map emitter via FUN_004C7150 passthrough. Sole caller FUN_00874570 (smallest of the family, just 26 bytes, no gate). Carries 0x238-byte body (largest in the cluster - copies 0x89=137 dwords from param_2).

Tier-D Map emitter via FUN_004C7150 passthrough. Sole caller FUN_008746E0(param_1, 0x1E=category=30). On success sets param_1+0xC=0 and param_1+0x14=0 (transitions to closed state). c2s side carries 264-byte payload starting with 00000000 03000000 02013200 0000... (per friendlist_search.pcapng observation).

RetainerItemSearchMarketplace - ItemSearchListWidget tick handler case 10 emit (called from FUN_00525E50 case 10). Reads widget field +0x1220, packs a 0x100-byte body block copied from FUN_00445210/004451F0 (string pool source pointer + size, identical to BCS-Y-0316 Chat helper pattern). Combined payload = 296 bytes including 0x40 dwords body. Gated on +0x123C == +0x1240. c2s sends 296-byte search criteria.

bazaarFindings.uiControlXrefs: All Button_Bazaar* controls referenced exclusively by FUN_00f0b7a0 (static data-section initializer that builds a control-name table - NOT a runtime click handler). s_bazaarStatusVisibility referenced by FUN_005024a0 (a widget visibility helper). s_marketItem referenced by FUN_0051b8f0 (a stride helper, generic).
bazaarFindings.conclusion: Bazaar does NOT have dedicated c2s opcodes in the 1.23b client static disassembly. The flow uses 3 layers: (1) Bazaar UI widget (BazaarEditWidget at 0x00f9da74) instantiates buttons + status text from static data; (2) Click events are dispatched into Lua via the event system using generic StartEvent/EventOpcode receivers (cluster 0x012E..0x01F5); (3) Server-side Lua handlers (BazaarTradeCommand.lua, BazaarCheckCommand.lua, BazaarDealCommand.lua, BazaarUndealCommand.lua) process the trades and emit standard inventory/gil/state-change s2c opcodes back. This is consistent with the dispatch-dichotomy documented in docs/network_dispatch_dual_paths.md - bazaar trade is queue-walk / event-driven, not per-opcode dispatch.

marketFindings.rttiHits: Only 3 string-literal hits, none are class names: s_marketItem (x2) and s_PrivateAreaMasterMarket. PrivateAreaMaster is the FFXIV 1.x designation for instanced sub-zones like the Retainer Marketplace area in Limsa Lominsa, Gridania, Ul'dah; not a packet opcode.
marketFindings.conclusion: No Market* opcode exists in 1.23b. The 1.x marketplace is a Retainer-Item-Search system, fully covered by opcodes 0x01D7..0x01DF (the RetainerItemSearchMarketplace cluster above).
marketFindings.reverifyMethod: live-validation against the retail 1.23b client in a live session

retainerSpawnFindings.rttiHits: No RetainerSpawn or Retainer* RTTI class for actor spawning. Retainers are spawned as standard NPCs via the Add/SpawnNpc family (Actor cluster opcodes 0x00CA AddActor + 0x00C9 SetActorPosition / 0x00CD SetActorAppearance etc per BCS-Y-0525/0526) and identified server-side as IsRetainer flag (s_isRetainer_00fd4cd0, single reader at FUN_006f8660 - a chara-state check helper).
retainerSpawnFindings.lobbySpawn: Retainer creation/selection occurs in the LOBBY (RetainerMenuPhase + CharaMakeOperation case 0x17 RetainerList per BCS-Y-0018), not the map. Once a retainer is materialized in the map (via the OrdinaryRetainer.lua / RetainerFurniture.lua scripts hosting a populace actor), it's an actor like any other.
retainerSpawnFindings.conclusion: No dedicated RetainerSpawn opcode. Lobby retainer list = 0x0017 (BCS-Y-0019 deserializer FUN_00DA4D80, 48-byte RetainerListRecord per BCS-S-0009). Map-side retainer summoning uses the generic actor-add opcode 0x00CA (BCS-Y-0525) with the IsRetainer flag carried in actor appearance data.

catalogChanges.summary: All Retainer/Bazaar/Market widget RTTI classes are either attributed through BCS-Y-0018/0019/0347 and BCS-S-0008/0009 or have no c2s wire binding. Bazaar uses Lua event dispatch, while BazaarEditWidget and RetainerListWidget have no opcode-emitting vtable slots. Opcodes 0x01D7, 0x01D8, and 0x01DF are ItemSearchListWidget tick-handler dispatches through FUN_00525E50.

openQuestions.question: Where do the s2c RetainerSearch* packets land in the client? client_receivers.json has no Retainer*Receiver / ItemSearch*Receiver. The cluster is likely queue-walk consumed (like linkshell chat in Q9) rather than slot-dispatched. Resolving requires either tracing how ItemSearchListWidget's tick handler at FUN_00525E50 reads incoming search results (look for the buffer feed path), or a live capture live capture of an active marketplace browse session.
openQuestions.deferral: live capture deferred per these conventions; queue-walk path tracing is a follow-on phase.

openQuestions.question: What is the 0x100-byte body block at FUN_00445210/004451F0 that 0x01DF embeds in its payload? Likely a search-query-criteria template (item-filter struct, name-substring buffer, etc.) but the loader is shared infrastructure used by other cluster opcodes (e.g. WorldServerbound 0x00C8 per BCS-Y-0316). Cataloging this loader's body format would tighten the c2s schema for 0x01DF specifically.
openQuestions.deferral: Not blocking - the 0x01DF binding is confirmed; the body shape characterization is an opcode-payload-schemas-style follow-on.
